question:
Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given group of words / phrase.

A drug or other substance that induces sleep
solution:
The correct answer is: Option(4) i.e. **Sedative**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Sedative"** means a drug or other substance that induces sleep or drowsiness. (नींद लाने वाली दवा)

 
 
• **Example:** The doctor prescribed a sedative to help the patient sleep better.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sedative**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Energetic** (ऊर्जावान): Showing or involving great activity or vitality.

 
 
• **Example:** The energetic children were playing outside all day.
 
 
 
• **Reviver** (पुनर्जीवित करने वाला): Something that revives or revitalizes.
 
 
• **Example:** The cold juice acted as a reviver on the hot summer day.
 
 
 
• **Stimulant** (उत्तेजक): A substance that raises levels of physiological or nervous activity in the body.
 
 
• **Example:** Caffeine is a common stimulant found in coffee.
